_comment: Gene set for data/splice_data.json. 'from_tab1': take the isoform ids already in data/utr_data.json (so tab 2 joins tab 1). 'extra': additional unversioned ENSTs to include (documented alternative-splicing events). Every 'event' string must be supported by the cite key(s), which must exist in SOURCES in build_splice.py.

genes.event: Cassette exons 2 and 3 of MAPT add N-terminal inserts of 29 or 58 amino acids (0N/1N/2N tau); exon 3 is never included without exon 2.

The two proteins of the CDKN2A locus, p16INK4a and p14ARF, are specified by translating the common second exon in alternative reading frames; each transcript starts at its own first exon (1alpha or 1beta), so the 5' UTR and the protein N-terminus both differ.

TP63 encodes multiple isotypes; the predominant p63 isotypes in many epithelial tissues (deltaNp63) lack the acidic N terminus corresponding to the transactivation domain of p53. The deltaNp63 transcript begins at an internal first exon that lies inside TAp63 intron 3 (Ensembl/GENCODE GRCh38 annotation).
The human p53 gene contains an internal promoter in intron 4 that transcribes the delta133p53 variants, whose coding sequence starts at codon 133, giving a different 5' UTR and N terminus.
